scope: One deployed AWS Session, three authenticated HTTP/SSE collaborators and real Luna inference; not three native desktop windows
checks: OIDC roles and fixed browser execution grant configured
Browser initialized in an idle Session with zero model Turns
Real agent created the page and used the browser
All three identities see the same live page after the Turn ends
Engineer navigation is visible to Designer and QA
Point, reply and region annotations propagate to three live streams with unique identity colors and idempotency
Collaborators can resolve and reopen the same durable feedback thread
Agent acknowledged all three nonce-bearing markers and read the visual-only code; label capitalization normalized
All four Turns completed and all annotation receipts dispatched
Three reauthenticated collaborators reconnect from revision zero and receive all five comments with the original captured image
Viewer can read the browser but cannot navigate or annotate; outsider cannot read
QA revocation closes the active stream and denies browser access while Designer and Engineer streams remain open
infrastructure_cost_note: Not attributed from AWS billing; inference subtotal is not total test spend. Disposable stack cleanup is recorded separately.
harness_correction: The original exact-capitalization assertion stalled on Engineer versus ENGINEER. The actual image code and all nonce-bearing markers were present. The same Session completed remaining permission/reconnect/revocation checks with reauthenticated disposable identities and no additional inference. Original failed evidence is retained.
limitations: Single sample, not a load benchmark
Cold worker replacement and browser state recovery not exercised
The final socket chmod/chown ordering correction was validated locally after this AWS run.
